subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - token volumes & licensing (FintechCo)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tsanders@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - token volumes & next steps (FintechCo)

Hi Tom / Kelly —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side after the discovery call:   

- Use case summary: customer support automation + KYC document summarization running in your VPC (low-latency, sensitive PII).
- Important constraints: on-prem access for audits, strict retention policy, and requirement for an enterprise support SLAs (24x7 L2+ escalation).

On pricing and sizing, a couple of asks so we can get a bespoke Private/VPC quote:   
1) Estimated steady-state token volumes (input + output) per month and expected burst factors.
2) Target unit economics — any internal target $/1M tokens we should aim for (or target monthly cost band).
3) Preferred licensing model: do you prefer an annual reserved capacity (dedicated GPU pools), a per-node license + usage multiplier, or a pure usage-based bill for Private (we can support hybrid).
4) Required environment count — how many separate VPCs/environments (prod, staging, dev, DR) need full isolation and support?

Attached is a short primer on our Private pricing model and an example volume worksheet (editable). If you can share ballpark numbers for 1) and 2) by EOD Monday we’ll produce a cost range and a recommended config (nodes, quantization profile, support tier).

Next steps:
- Tom: send estimated monthly token volumes and the internal budget range.
- Ben/Marissa: deliver 2 pricing scenarios (conservative & aggressive) + recommended licensing/support options.

Thanks — talk soon.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Plan.pdf (pdf, 420KB)
Attachment: fintechco_token_volume_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx, 30KB)

From: Tom Sanders <tsanders@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kelly Nguyen <knguyen@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - token volumes & next steps (FintechCo)

Ben — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few quick numbers from our side after internal sync: 

- Steady-state tokens: ~180M tokens / month (combined input+output) for initial deployment; planning for up to 350M/month within 12 months if we enable more user flows.
- Burst tolerance: peaks ~2.5x weekly during market hours.
- Budget range: target $2k–$6k per 1M tokens as a guideline for initial procurement approval; our finance prefers to see a capped committed rate for the first year.
- Licensing preference: leaning toward an annual reserved capacity model (dedicated GPU pools) + a small overage usage rate. We need predictability for budgeting.
- Environments: 3 full environments (prod, staging, pre-prod); dev can be shared but we'd like a DR/backup that can be warmed in 24 hours. So count=4 for licensing purposes.

We can share a more detailed token breakdown (by workflow) next week — sending the spreadsheet to your team. Also looping in procurement to start SOW/contract conversations.

Tom
Tom Sanders | Head of AI Platform, FintechCo
tsanders@fintechco.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tsanders@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - token volumes & next steps (FintechCo)

Tom — really helpful, thanks. Based on the numbers you gave, we’ll prepare two scenarios for your procurement:

1) Conservative commit (initial rollout):
   - Committed reserved capacity sized for ~200M tokens/month steady-state, with burst pool to cover 2.5x weekly spikes.
   - Licensing: annual reserved capacity fee (covers dedicated GPU nodes + management) + overage pricing at a blended rate.
   - Support: Enterprise Support (24x7 L2 + named technical account manager).
   - Environments: 3 fully isolated environments + a warm DR.
   - Estimated unit economics: target $/1M tokens range we’ll show: $3,800 — $5,500 depending on quantization profile and caching.

2) Aggressive commit (12-mo growth plan):
   - Commit for ~350M tokens/month with higher reserved capacity and lower overage rate.
   - Licensing: deeper discount on annual reserved fee; additional support hours included for model onboarding.
   - Support: Platinum SLA (faster escalation, quarterly on-site review if needed).
   - Environments: same environment count; optional additional staging for partner previews.
   - Estimated unit economics: $2,200 — $3,500 / 1M tokens.

A few clarifying questions so we can firm up the worksheets and SOW:
- For procurement, do you require line-item pricing split (license vs infra vs support)? Most customers prefer three-line split; we can provide that.
- For compliance: will you need us to push logs to your SIEM or is audit-only access sufficient? That affects support/eng scope.
- Do you have a preferred contract length (1yr vs 3yr) — longer terms unlock deeper discounts.

I’ll loop Marissa for the formal quote and Marcus on infra sizing. We’ll aim to send the two scenarios + line-item breakdown by EOD Monday PST. If procurement wants an initial redline, we can attach a draft SOW for review.

Ben

From: Kelly Nguyen <knguyen@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Sanders <tsanders@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - token volumes & next steps (FintechCo)

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement asked that we confirm a few items before you send the formal quote:

- We do want a three-line split (license vs infra vs support). Please include estimated amortized hardware replacement costs if you include on-prem packaged installs.
- Preferred contract term: initial 12-month with option to extend to 36 months after year-one review.
- Can you include target SLA metrics for median latency at 75th and 99th percentiles in the quote? We will need those for our Risk review.

If you include those items we can route the draft SOW to procurement next week. Looking forward to the scenarios on Monday.

Thanks,
Kelly
Kelly Nguyen | Director, Procurement, FintechCo
knguyen@fintechco.com
